prompt: Write the clause that filters the groups after grouping, keeping only groups that have more than one row: HAVING with COUNT(*) greater than 1.
given: Query: SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM commits WHERE committed_offset > 50 GROUP BY group_id <your clause>
template:
-- EXPECTED: [["analytics", 2], ["billing", 2]]

-- Tables are loaded for you: partitions(topic, partition_id, log_end_offset) and commits(group_id, topic, partition_id, committed_offset).
SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM commits
WHERE committed_offset > 50
GROUP BY group_id

ORDER BY group_id;
why: HAVING with COUNT(*) filters groups after grouping.
